name: breakout
title: Breakout
description: A reading column that a figure or a band can step out of, wider or to the edges.
use: An article, a changelog or a story: running text at a reading measure, centred, with a picture, a table or a band of color that is allowed to be wider. Everything inside reads in the column without a class; give breakout-wide or breakout-full only to what leaves it. A column that nothing leaves is written with utilities alone: a max width and mx-auto.

instead.when: The page is a frame of regions, not one column of reading

platform.fallback: A wide or full child stays in the column; the reading column itself is unchanged

classes.name: breakout
classes.description: The grid: one column at most --breakout-measure wide and --breakout-gutter from either edge, centred, with 1.25rem between children. An inline-size container. It draws nothing

classes.name: breakout-wide
classes.description: A child up to --breakout-wide wider on each side, as far as the room beside the column allows and never into the gutter

classes.name: breakout-full
classes.description: A child that runs to both edges of the breakout

properties.name: --breakout-measure
properties.description: The widest the column may be: about 70 characters of body text

properties.name: --breakout-wide
properties.description: How far a wide child may reach past the column on each side

properties.name: --breakout-gutter
properties.description: The least room kept between the column and an edge, and between a wide child and an edge

example:
The north ridge

We left before the light, while the snow was still hard.

The ridge took four hours.
